scope.rule: Independent current-state review; does not modify author drafts. Fixed primary witness and article-body reads only.

statusDefinitions.pass: Current primary facts/gates and active secondary link are supported with no material issue found.
statusDefinitions.qualified: Current portrayal is supportable but article is related/ambiguous, null/excluded, or a non-blocking caveat remains.
statusDefinitions.fail: A concrete source, occurrence, or display-gate correction is required.
statusDefinitions.unlinked-unsearched: No link is currently set; no claim of independently searched no-fit.
